as j from_json unsorted-json/unsorted.json
to_json @j
keys @j
as sorted canon @j
to_json @sorted
equals @j $sorted
as y from_yaml unsorted-yaml/unsorted.yaml
to_yaml @y
to_json @y
as t from_toml unsorted-toml/unsorted.toml
to_toml @t
to_json @t
as js from_json --sort unsorted-json/unsorted.json
to_json @js
as ys from_yaml -s unsorted-yaml/unsorted.yaml
to_json @ys
as ts from_toml --sort unsorted-toml/unsorted.toml
to_json @ts
to_json --sort @j
to_yaml -s @j
to_toml --sort @t
to_strh --sort @j 1299709 104729 1
to_strh @j 1299709 104729 1
as index arr 0.:str="b" 0.:str="a" 0.:str="10" 0.:str="2" 0.:str="z" 0.:str="y"
to_strt --sort @j $index
to_strt @j $index
from_strh unsorted-strh/unsorted.strh
from_strh --sort unsorted-strh/unsorted.strh
from_strt unsorted-strt/unsorted.strt $index
from_strt -s unsorted-strt/unsorted.strt $index
